messages:
maria_sec: Heads up — after the RBAC refactor landed in private-controlplane, several on-prem customers reported 403s when trying to use the admin UI and the bastion workflows. Can we triage?
raj_infra: saw the alerts. Looks like the allowlist lookup returned an empty set for some tenant_ids. Could be the cache invalidation change in last deploy.
alex_onprem: repro steps from a customer: curl to controlplane returns 403, but service account tokens still work for API calls. UI actions which call the "check-admin" endpoint fail.
jen_prodsec: tagging @maria_sec @raj_infra — suspected area: role-mapping service change that tightened source-ip checks. We added privsep layer to decouple node-local checks, maybe it didn't get the VPC allowlist fallback.
samir_ops: logs from the proxy: ``ERROR auth: no matching allowlist entry for tenant=acme-prod src_ip=10.1.2.45 fallback=disabled`` — fallback being disabled is unexpected.
raj_infra: I pulled the rollout diff: we changed default for "allowlist_fallback_enabled" to false in config v2. That was intended for hosted nodes, but the private controlplane deploy manifest didn't override it.
maria_sec: Oof. So private deployments began inheriting the new default. That explains the 403s. Two problems: config default drift and audit trail — customers need to know what changed.
jen_prodsec: Any sign of privilege leakage? Were any admin actions allowed incorrectly?
alex_onprem: Not that I can see. The tighter check only dropped some admin UI flows. API tokens still respected role-bindings. No "allow" regressions in logs.
raj_infra: Quick mitigation: enabling fallback in the config and redeploying the controlplane. I've prepared a patch: ``config.private_controlplane.allowlist_fallback_enabled = true`` — planning a canary to 2 tenants.
samir_ops: Can we hotpatch proxy behavior to accept the previous implicit fallback until config patch rolls out? Might be faster for stuck customers.
maria_sec: We should avoid divergence between hosted and private defaults again. Action items: 1) rollback default change in main repo (jen please own), 2) push a targeted fix to private-controlplane manifests (raj to deploy canary), 3) notify impacted customers with a short blurb and include how to validate when fixed (alex), 4) add audit entries for the config change (maria to run).
jen_prodsec: I'll open a PR to revert the default and add an explicit override flag per deployment type. Also adding unit tests to catch cross-environment defaults.
alex_onprem: Draft customer message: "We deployed a configuration change that tightened VPC allowlist fallback defaults for private control planes. This caused admin UI flows to return 403s for some customers. We have a fix rolling out and a canary is live — expected full remediation within 30 minutes. No data was accessed or altered." Thoughts?
maria_sec: good. Add the exact timestamps and the rollout id. Also include steps customers can run: ``curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://controlplane.example.com/_internal/check-admin`` — should return ``{"status":"ok"}`` when fixed.
samir_ops: audit-bot: forwarding latest config-change event to splunk: index=redwood-audit source=config-service action=update user=jen_prodsec change="allowlist_fallback_enabled:false->true (canary)"
audit-bot: NOTE: matched correlation id 0x7f9a3 for the original deploy where default flipped last night.
maria_sec: Also we need to confirm KMS signing for the config manifest — was the manifest signed and rotated? If unsigned, we should treat as higher severity.
raj_infra: Manifest signed by CI key 0x8bcb — signature verified. KMS wrap + key-id log present. No anomalies.
jen_prodsec: PR opened: #4421 revert default + env-specific override, added unit test. Will request review from @maria_sec and @raj_infra.
alex_onprem: Can we add an automated smoke test for private-controlplane that simulates a tenant with an empty allowlist cache? Prevents silent regressions.
maria_sec: yes — add to nightly suite. Also add an alert for sudden spike in 403s from admin endpoints with tag private-controlplane.
raj_infra: Canary patch applied to 2 tenants at 12:11 UTC. Monitoring: admin-403s dropped to baseline for those tenants. Pushing to remaining 18 on-prem instances now.
samir_ops: For postmortem: root cause = config default drift during refactor + missing env-specific override + missing smoke test. Actionables assigned. Severity: P2.
maria_sec: thanks team. Alex, send customer note. Jen, merge the revert once approved. Raj, finish rollouts and post final status. Closing thread when customers ack. :white_check_mark:
